title: ExtorQ - Kubernetes Investigation
description: Kubernetes clusters: API audit (verbs, denials, RBAC changes, exec into Pods, secret access, Pod admissions), workload authentication failures and the node / workload / Service hierarchy. Sources: k8s.audit and k8s.container_log (OTel collector in the cluster), k8s.api_inventory. The audit policy decides which requests are logged.

panels.title: API requests by verb
panels.description: Audited Kubernetes API requests per verb. Source: k8s.audit (API server audit log). Volume only; the audit policy decides which requests appear.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, ifNull(k8s_verb, 'unknown') AS verb,
       uniqExact(event_id) AS requests
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
GROUP BY time, verb
ORDER BY time, verb

panels.title: Denied requests (403) by user
panels.description: Requests rejected with HTTP 403 (RBAC or Pod Security admission) per user. Source: k8s.audit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, ifNull(k8s_user, 'unknown') AS user,
       uniqExact(event_id) AS denied
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
  AND k8s_response_code = 403
GROUP BY time, user
ORDER BY time, user

panels.title: Resources by verb
panels.description: Audited requests per (resource, verb) with denials and distinct users. Source: k8s.audit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(k8s_resource, 'unknown') AS resource, ifNull(k8s_verb, 'unknown') AS verb,
       uniqExact(event_id) AS requests,
       uniqExactIf(event_id, k8s_response_code = 403) AS denied,
       uniqExact(k8s_user) AS users
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
GROUP BY resource, verb
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Denied requests
panels.description: 403 responses, newest first, including Pod Security violations (K8S-001 inputs: a privileged Pod refused by an enforcing namespace). Source: k8s.audit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, k8s_user AS user, k8s_verb AS verb, k8s_resource AS resource,
       k8s_namespace AS namespace, k8s_object_name AS object, k8s_response_code AS code,
       arrayStringConcat(k8s_source_ips, ', ') AS source_ips,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'pod_security_violation') AS pod_security_violation
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
  AND k8s_response_code = 403
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: RBAC changes
panels.description: Role and binding changes from the audit log and from inventory diffs with risk flags: the K8S-002 inputs. Sources: k8s.audit, k8s.api_inventory. risk_flags is empty when none were computed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, event_type, k8s_user AS user, k8s_verb AS verb,
       ifNull(k8s_resource, resource_type) AS resource,
       ifNull(k8s_namespace, resource_namespace) AS namespace,
       ifNull(k8s_object_name, resource_name) AS object, k8s_response_code AS code, outcome,
       arrayStringConcat(JSONExtract(attributes, 'risk_flags', 'Array(String)'), ', ') AS risk_flags
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND ((event_type = 'k8s.api.request' AND k8s_resource IN ('roles', 'rolebindings', 'clusterroles', 'clusterrolebindings')
        AND k8s_verb IN ('create', 'update', 'patch', 'delete'))
       OR (event_type IN ('k8s.resource.created', 'k8s.resource.updated',
                          'k8s.resource.deleted')
           AND lower(ifNull(resource_type, '')) IN ('role', 'rolebinding', 'clusterrole',
               'clusterrolebinding', 'roles', 'rolebindings', 'clusterroles', 'clusterrolebindings')))
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Interactive exec and attach into Pods
panels.description: kubectl exec / attach sessions into Pods, newest first (K8S-003 inputs). Source: k8s.audit. The command itself is not stored (only the request path, redacted).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, k8s_user AS user, k8s_namespace AS namespace, k8s_object_name AS pod,
       k8s_subresource AS subresource, k8s_verb AS verb, k8s_response_code AS code,
       arrayStringConcat(k8s_source_ips, ', ') AS source_ips
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
  AND k8s_resource = 'pods' AND k8s_subresource IN ('exec', 'attach')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Secret access
panels.description: Reads of Secret objects, newest first; scope 'all namespaces' is a cluster-wide list (K8S-004 inputs). Source: k8s.audit. Controllers read secrets routinely: look at the user. Secret values are never collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, k8s_user AS user, k8s_verb AS verb,
       if(ifNull(k8s_namespace, '') = '', 'all namespaces', k8s_namespace) AS scope,
       k8s_object_name AS secret, k8s_response_code AS code,
       arrayStringConcat(k8s_source_ips, ', ') AS source_ips
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
  AND k8s_resource = 'secrets' AND k8s_verb IN ('get', 'list', 'watch')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Pod creations and admission outcome
panels.description: Pod create requests with the admission result: 201 admitted, 403 refused (K8S-001 refused privileged Pods, K8S-005 privileged or host-namespace Pods that were admitted). Source: k8s.audit; request_summary is the normaliser's summary of the Pod spec (truncated to 300 characters).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time, k8s_user AS user, k8s_namespace AS namespace, k8s_object_name AS pod,
       k8s_response_code AS code,
       JSONExtractString(attributes, 'pod_security_violation') AS pod_security_violation,
       substring(JSONExtractRaw(attributes, 'request_summary'), 1, 300) AS request_summary
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND event_type = 'k8s.api.request'
  AND k8s_resource = 'pods' AND ifNull(k8s_subresource, '') = '' AND k8s_verb = 'create'
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 1 BY event_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Workload authentication failures
panels.description: Structured authentication failures that applications write to their container logs (the lab-portal web app logs login failures as JSON), per Pod. Source: k8s.container_log.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time,
       concat(ifNull(k8s_namespace, '?'), '/', ifNull(k8s_pod_name, '?')) AS pod,
       uniqExact(event_id) AS failures
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND source_type = 'k8s.container_log'
  AND category = 'authentication' AND outcome IN ('failure', 'denied')
GROUP BY time, pod
ORDER BY time, pod

panels.title: Container log volume by namespace
panels.description: Container log events per namespace, collected by the OTel DaemonSet. Source: k8s.container_log. Volume only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, ifNull(k8s_namespace, 'unknown') AS namespace,
       uniqExact(event_id) AS lines
FROM extorq.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND source_type = 'k8s.container_log'
GROUP BY time, namespace
ORDER BY time, namespace

panels.title: Hierarchy: nodes, workloads, Kubernetes Services, Pods
Kubernetes nodes
panels.description: Current state: node assets (k8s:<cluster>/node/<name>) and their cluster. Source: v_assets (Kubernetes inventory collector).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT asset_id, name, parent_asset_id AS cluster, last_seen, observed_by
FROM extorq.v_assets
WHERE asset_type = 'kubernetes_node'
ORDER BY asset_id
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Workloads and Kubernetes Services
panels.description: Current state: workloads (controllers or bare Pods) and logical Kubernetes Service objects (virtual IP and ports, never a host OS service). Source: v_services (Kubernetes inventory collector). Coverage: unsupported = no adapter; planned = extension point only, no telemetry; unmonitored = adapter not enabled; degraded = stale/failing (also when the discovery record is older than 1 h); monitored = enabled and fresh. The console/API also checks collector staleness per telemetry source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT asset_id, service_kind AS kind, service_key AS key, name, category,
       adapter_id AS adapter, multiIf(adapter_support = 'none', 'unsupported', adapter_support = 'planned', 'planned', monitoring_status = 'unmonitored', 'unmonitored', monitoring_status = 'degraded', 'degraded', last_seen < now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR, 'degraded (stale record)', 'monitored') AS coverage, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(e -> concat(JSONExtractString(e, 'protocol'), '/', toString(JSONExtractUInt(e, 'port')), ' ', JSONExtractString(e, 'exposure'), ' (', JSONExtractString(e, 'attribution'), ')'), JSONExtractArrayRaw(endpoints)), ', ') AS endpoints,
       instance_count, last_seen AS discovery_refreshed
FROM extorq.v_services
WHERE present = 1 AND service_kind IN ('k8s_workload', 'k8s_service')
ORDER BY asset_id, kind, key
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Pods and containers
panels.description: Current state: Pod and container instances of Kubernetes workloads (latest version, present only) with the node they run on. Source: v_service_instances_current (Kubernetes inventory collector).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.namespace AS namespace, i.pod_name AS pod, i.container_name AS container,
       i.instance_kind AS kind, i.state AS state, i.node_name AS node,
       i.workload_kind AS workload_kind, i.workload_name AS workload, i.image AS image,
       i.observed_at AS observed_at, i.pod_uid AS pod_uid, i.container_id AS container_id
FROM extorq.v_service_instances_current AS i
WHERE i.instance_kind IN ('pod', 'container')
ORDER BY namespace, pod, container
LIMIT 500
